title: Rich Media & Inventory Dashboard
result_summary: Added sendImage to WhatsAppService. Exposed Inventory API. Implemented InventoryList frontend component. Build verified.

acceptance_criteria: Backend sends an image message to WhatsApp (or mock log)
Frontend Dashboard displays the list of properties from the DB
